content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need leaves commercially available chemicals, total price <= $9999.

We have some candidate building blocks: para-methyl aniline (Cc1ccc(N)cc1) price cheap 28.6. Also sulfonyl chloride (ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1) cheap 25.3. Also maybe aniline derivative for second phenyl amide: aniline (c3ccccc3N) but we need amide with C=O attached to trans-alkene. Could use trans-cinnamoyl aniline? Actually target has C=O attached to aniline (Nc3ccccc3N) i.e., anilide with aniline as amine (primary) attached to carbonyl of cinnamoyl (C=O) and then double bond to phenyl sulfonyl group.

The substructure: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH (anilide). So we could make the cinnamoyl anilide via coupling of trans-cinnamic acid (or its activated derivative) with 4-aminophenyl? Wait the amide is between carbonyl and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So we need aniline (aniline) reacting with trans-cinnamic acid (or its activated acid chloride) to give trans-cinnamoyl aniline (C=O attached to aniline). Then we need to attach that to sulfonyl phenyl via a sulfonamide linking to para-methyl aniline.

Overall route: Step 1: Synthesize sulfonyl chloride (or purchase) ClSO2-Ph (para-substituted phenyl). Actually we need sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl that later will be coupled with para-methyl aniline to give sulfonamide. So we can purchase p-toluidine (para-methyl aniline) as starting material (cheap). Also purchase p-tolylsulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-Ph-CH3). But the target sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl that is para-substituted with the cinnamoyl anilide. Wait the sulfonyl is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2) which is para to the sulfonamide connection? The SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Interpretation: A tolyl (methyl phenyl) attached via NH to sulfonyl group attached to another phenyl (phenyl-sulfonyl). That second phenyl has para substituent of trans-cinnamoyl anilide (C= C - C(=O)N-Ph-NH). So the sulfonyl phenyl is unsubstituted except for that para substituent.

Thus retrosynthesis: Disconnection 1: Break sulfonamide N-S bond to give p-toluidine (para-methyl aniline) and aryl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid). The aryl sulfonyl chloride would be 4-(trans-cinnamoyl-anilide) phenyl sulfonyl chloride.

So step 1: p-toluidine + aryl sulfonyl chloride -> target (sulfonamide formation). That's a simple step.

Step 2: The aryl sulfonyl chloride can be made from the corresponding phenyl sulfonic acid (or from chlorosulfonation of the phenyl). But we can also purchase the sulfonyl chloride directly if available. However we need the phenyl bearing the trans-cinnamoyl anilide substituent. Could we purchase that phenyl sulfonyl chloride? Likely not. So we need to synthesize it: start from 4-bromo phenyl (or 4-iodo) then do sulfonyl chloride formation? Another route: start from 4-aminophenyl (or 4-hydroxy) and convert to sulfonyl chloride via oxidation? Might be complex.

Alternative retrosynthesis: Break the C=C double bond to give aldehyde and amide? Could use Heck coupling? But we need max 3 steps.

Maybe better: Use Suzuki coupling to attach the phenyl sulfonyl group to the tolyl? Actually the sulfonamide is formed directly.

We need commercially available building blocks: p-toluidine, 4-(trans-cinnamoyl-anilide) phenyl sulfonyl chloride (maybe not available). Could we instead form sulfonamide later after installing the cinnamoyl anilide onto phenyl via Suzuki coupling? For example, start with 4-bromo phenyl sulfonyl chloride (commercial) and do Suzuki coupling with phenyl boronic acid bearing the cinnamoyl anilide? That seems more steps.

Maybe we can break the C=O amide bond: disconnect amide to give aniline and cinnamic acid derivative. So step 2: amide formation between aniline (c3ccccc3N) and trans-cinnamic acid (or its activated acid chloride). The trans-cinnamic acid is commercially available? Search.
